name: CJC-1295 (With DAC)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: CJC-1295 (With DAC) (CD) is a structurally modified synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 3 pack sizes: 2 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is CJC-1295 (With DAC) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: CJC-1295 (With DAC) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the CD certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 446262-90-4, formula C165H269N47O46, 3647.2 Da).

faq.question: How should CJC-1295 (With DAC) be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for CJC-1295 (With DAC): store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the CD lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for CJC-1295 (With DAC)?
faq.answer: CJC-1295 (With DAC) is stocked in 3 pack sizes (2 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $79.24; 10–49 kits falls to $72.90 (−8%) and 50+ to $67.36 (−15%).
